amendments.reason: the first run stopped at the close-capability preflight before any window was scored: time_stop needs bars_held, which no live close context supplies, so a strict comparison refuses it; the research simulator supplies bars_held, and the issue requires time_stop as the close owner

candidate_full.role: the full signal contract; needs quotes

price_only_event.role: diagnostic: identical calendar eligibility, exits, sizing and costs, without the spread gate; never a pass

calendar.coverage: [2025-01-01, 2027-01-01) UTC for regularly scheduled statements; unscheduled notation votes are not scheduled releases and are excluded
calendar.publication_rule: a record is eligible only with known_ms from an official release that names the date and the statement time before the release; the 2023 and 2024 tentative schedules name dates only, so their records carry known_ms null and are never eligible

holding_rule: time_stop max_bars must equal params.holding_bars; run_study.py refuses any arm that breaks it

matched_control.label: research controls, never official releases
matched_control.rule: for each eligible official statement, a research control at the same weekday and 2 p.m. ET local time 7 days before and 7 days after, skipped within 3 days of any official statement; each control inherits its source event's publication time

name: macro_event_breakout

proxy.costs: eval_windows platform fees for hyperliquid perps (the cached-path cost model)
proxy.label: Binance US spot 1h candles (BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT), a price proxy for Hyperliquid perpetuals

quotes.reason: no historical Hyperliquid bid/ask archive with per-decision receipt times was available to this study; the current l2Book snapshot is a cost assumption only and never feeds the spread gate

selection.applies_to: candidate_full and price_only_control use the same selected parameters with only spread_gate or the calendar changed
selection.eligible: both datasets scored, funding complete, no liquidation

status: frozen before any study window was scored

venue.costs: manifest execution specification: taker and maker fee, half spread from one l2Book snapshot (a cost assumption), slippage, szDecimals lot flooring, $10 minimum notional, hourly funding

verdict.fail: complete coverage and samples, and a pass condition is missed
verdict.inconclusive: any missing point-in-time input (quotes, calendar publication), fewer than 30 independent events, a funding gap, or a missing selection
verdict.live_status: production_refused regardless of the verdict; promotion needs a separate reviewed decision
verdict.pass: needs every one: quote coverage of at least 0.9 of event-window decisions for candidate_full; at least 30 independent official events with a position in held_out; complete funding; candidate_full net positive at base and stress cost on the venue leg and on the proxy leg; candidate_full beats price_only_control on mean net return with a worst drawdown no larger
